Beast God Afla Dilith is one of the four Fallen Gods of Grand Gaia, he rules over the region of Vriksha.

sections.title: History
sections.content:
Among the Divine Ten, Afla Dilith ruled over conflict and victory. Afla Dilith's creed was that conflict built strength for all involved, and that strife would produce a brighter future. This philosophy, according to His belief, was necessary to keep the world in an orderly system. However, He was branded as Fallen God when He applied that philosophy to rule Grand Gaia.

Afla Dilith was known for His ability to absorb anything. One day, a disciple incurred Afla Dilith's wrath and He absorbed the disciple. This enraged the disciple's friend, who then challenged Him into a duel. This disciple was successful in recovering the power that had been stolen from his friend when battling Afla Dilith, but an interruption from His disciple, Zurg, forced the disciple to flee.

After the disappearance of a fellow member of Divine Ten, Afla Dilith ordered to exterminate all sacred beasts. It was that time when He met a dragon who was looking for the truth of its friend's disappearance. Afla Dilith halted the dragon and they engaged in a heated battle. The Beast God then mocked Kulyuk in front of the dragon during their fight, causing the dragon's rage to explode. Before the dragon died, it made a revelation to Afla Dilith: Someday in the future, a mighty human would come to bring an end to the Beast God.

Afla Dilith shows up as a Boss Battle in Wolf's Lair, at the final stage, and challenges the Summoner. Afla Dilith met his demise in Summoner's hand, just like the revelation Bestalg had brought upon him.
